Engine commit: **61ce1c6**. Target TFM: **.NET Framework v4.6.2** under **Mono + Xvfb** on Linux. Goal: boot the REAL `RealPlugin` headless, feed it IINACT log lines, run ALL triggers (including Roslyn `ExecuteScript`), capture resolved callouts.

## 1. VERDICT

**Strategy A (run the REAL unmodified `RealPlugin.InitPlugin` under Mono+Xvfb with `cfg.UseScarborough=false`, constructing the real WinForms `UserInterface` but never showing the TabPage) is the only ZERO-PATCH path, and it is VIABLE but not certifiable from source alone. Confidence: MEDIUM (≈60%).** [RESOLVED 2026-06-28: Strategy A was built, proven, and shipped in v1.1.0-master. The MEDIUM confidence is historical; the gating risks below all cleared.]

The reasoning is forced by the adversarial verdict, which I re-verified: there is **no UI-less seam**. `InitPlugin` is one monolithic try/catch (`RealPlugin.cs:2223-2395`) that constructs the WinForms UI **unconditionally** at `RealPlugin.cs:2261` (`ui = new CustomControls.UserInterface();` - verified), and the **only** code that ever populates the engine's active trigger lists is `RealPlugin.AddTrigger` (`RealPlugin.cs:1220`), whose only callers are `CustomControls/UserInterface.cs:453/535/1067` (all inside the UI tree walk) and the repo path `RealPlugin.cs:2708` (verified by full-source grep - no other callers exist). **Skip the UI → zero triggers register → nothing ever fires.** There is no engine-side local loader.

Because a truly UI-less boot is BLOCKED in unmodified source, Strategy A deliberately **keeps** the real `UserInterface` (it is the trigger loader) and only neutralizes the overlay (config-gated, free) and the audio/window-monitor hazards. This means Strategy A is not "no UI". It is "UI constructed, never displayed." It satisfies the operational goal (headless callouts) without a source patch.

**Single biggest risk:** that Mono's `System.Windows.Forms` + `libgdiplus` cannot construct the full `CustomControls.UserInterface` (TreeView, ImageList, ToolStrip, DataGridViewEx, custom-painted controls, toast panels) under Xvfb without throwing - OR that the **unguarded** `tts = new SpeechSynthesizer()` at `RealPlugin.cs:2287` (verified; System.Speech) throws on Mono. Either throw is swallowed by the outer catch (`2391-2394`), leaving `isInitialized=false` and **silently disabling everything with no error**. This is a single runtime smoke test (Spike step 4) that decides A vs B. If it fails, fall back to Strategy B (in-assembly source patch). [RESOLVED 2026-06-28: the smoke test passed under Mono+Xvfb: the real `UserInterface` constructs and InitPlugin reaches `isInitialized=true`. Strategy A taken, B not needed; System.Speech handled per §3 item 3.]

## 2. STUB HOST SKELETON (Strategy A - mirror `ProxyPlugin.InitPlugin` minus the ACT form)

Reference host is `TriggernometryProxy/ProxyPlugin.cs` (the `IActPluginV1` we mirror). Ordered boot sequence on a dedicated **STA thread running a live message pump**:

```
STA thread main():
  Application.EnableVisualStyles()                       // best-effort under Mono
  Form F   = new Form();  F.ShowInTaskbar=false;         // throwaway mainform (RealPlugin.cs:366 is generic Form)
  TabPage TP = new TabPage();                            // pluginScreenSpace arg to InitPlugin
  Form host = new Form(); host.Controls.Add(TP-host...)  // TP must live on a created-handle container
  // force handles BEFORE init so ReadyForOperation() can ever be true:
  var _ = F.Handle;  F.CreateControl();                  // F.IsHandleCreated == true  (RealPlugin.cs:3979)

  RealPlugin.ResetPlugin();                              // verified static, RealPlugin.cs:1082
  var plug = RealPlugin.plug;                            // verified static, RealPlugin.cs:1072
  plug.mainform   = F;                                   // RealPlugin.cs:366 / ProxyPlugin.cs:138
  plug.pluginName = "Triggernometry";                    // public, RealPlugin.cs:341
  plug.path       = <writable cfg dir>;                  // config.xml + RemoteSounds live here
  plug.pluginPath = <engine dir>;                        // public, RealPlugin.cs:342

  // --- register hooks BEFORE InitPlugin (ProxyPlugin uses FailsafeRegisterHook, :145-163) ---
  RealPlugin.InstanceHook   = (n,t) => FakeInstance(); // static! see §5      (RealPlugin.cs:387)
  plug.ActInitedHook        = () => true;              // MANDATORY            (RealPlugin.cs:3979)
  plug.InCombatHook         = () => false;             // Context.cs:699/706
  plug.TtsPlaybackHook      = text       => Sink.Tts(text);     // CAPTURE     (RealPlugin.cs:1660)
  plug.SoundPlaybackHook    = (file,vol) => Sink.Sound(file,vol);// CAPTURE    (RealPlugin.cs:1682)
  // defensive 2nd-tier stubs (unguarded if a trigger uses the feature):
  plug.CurrentZoneHook        = () => currentZoneName;
  plug.SetCombatStateHook     = b => {};               // ActionActInteraction.cs:94
  plug.LogAllNetworkHook      = b => {};               // :97
  plug.UseDeucalionHook       = b => {};               // :100
  plug.ActiveEncounterHook    = () => "";              // Context.cs:2232
  plug.LastEncounterHook      = () => "";              // Context.cs:2227
  plug.EncounterDurationHook  = () => 0.0;             // Context.cs:708
  plug.ACTEncounterLogHook    = m => {};               // ActionLogMessage.cs:212
  // leave UI/import-only hooks null: CustomTriggerCheck/CustomTrigger/CornerShow/
  //   CornerHide/TabLocate (never reached headless); CheckUpdateHook avoided via config below
  // CORRECTION 2026-06-27: CornerShow/CornerHide are NOT actually unreached headless. QueueToast (UserInterface.cs:220)
  //   calls CornerShowHook UNGUARDED, so the host MUST stub CornerShow/CornerHide (else InitPlugin NPEs). See SPIKE-LOG.

  plug.InitPlugin(TP, new Label());                    // the REAL InitPlugin (RealPlugin.cs:2223)

  Application.Run(host);                               // keep pump alive: ui.Invoke / mainform.Invoke need it
```

**Config (the decisive routing changes).** `cfg`/`_cfg` are internal/private, so a separate-assembly host cannot set them directly. **Ship a preset `<pluginName>.config.xml` in `plug.path`** which `LoadConfigFromFile` reads at `RealPlugin.cs:2242`. Preset:
- `<UseScarborough>false</UseScarborough>` - overlay off (`RealPlugin.cs:2347`; default is **true** at `Configuration.cs:518`, so this MUST be set).
- `<WindowToMonitor></WindowToMonitor>` - empty (default `"FINAL FANTASY XIV"` at `Configuration.cs:515`) so `VerifyProcessWindow` (`RealPlugin.cs:3445`) skips the `user32 FindWindow` P/Invoke on the unguarded `AuraUpdateThread`.
- `<TtsMethod>ACT</TtsMethod>` and `<SoundMethod>ACT</SoundMethod>` (defaults are `Triggernometry` at `Configuration.cs:183/174`) so audio routes through our hooks (`TtsPlaybackSmart` 1850→1660; `SoundPlaybackSmart` 1910→1682) instead of `SpeechSynthesizer`/`WindowsMediaPlayer`.
- `<StartEndpointOnLaunch>false</StartEndpointOnLaunch>` unless the WebsocketSharp endpoint is wanted (default true, `Configuration.cs:228`; it is pure-managed so harmless, but unneeded).
- Update-check method ≠ ACT, so `CheckUpdateHook` (`RealPlugin.cs:2844`) is never invoked (leave it null).
- **Merge the trigger pack into `cfg.Root` inside this config.xml** so the real `ui.BuildFullTreeFromConfiguration()` (`RealPlugin.cs:2319`) registers them via `AddTrigger` - this is exactly why Strategy A keeps the UI (see §4).

**Repositories:** do NOT configure any (`AllRepositoryUpdates` auto-fires at `RealPlugin.cs:2384-2388`, and the repo path derefs `ui.treeView1` at `2723/2735`). In Strategy A the real `ui` exists so this is non-fatal, but skip repos to avoid network + routing-rewrite surprises (`2672-2673` rewrites routing to `Triggernometry`).

## 4. LOG IN / CALLOUT OUT

**Feeding IINACT lines (public methods, no ACT plumbing).** Per IINACT line, call BOTH:
```
plug.OnLogLineRead(false, line, currentZoneName);   // RealPlugin.cs:3682 → Log → ActiveTextTriggers
plug.BeforeLogLineRead(false, line, currentZoneName);// RealPlugin.cs:3657 → NetworkFFXIV → ActiveFFXIVNetworkTriggers
```
Both must be fed. Trigger `Source` defaults to `Log` (`Trigger.cs:52`) so ~95% of a real pack flows through `OnLogLineRead`, but packs also carry explicit `FFXIVNetwork` triggers (Lexxie: 287; TEA: 12) that only fire via `BeforeLogLineRead`. Each builds a `LogEvent` and enqueues via internal `LogLineQueuer` → `EventQueue` + `QueueWakeupEvent.Set()` (`RealPlugin.cs:3361`). The `LogLineProcessorThread` (`3404`) drains and dispatches by `SourceEnum` (`LogLine.cs:13`) to the four active lists (`3534-3595`) → `TestTrigger` (`3236`) → regex `CheckMatch` → `Trigger.Fire`.

- **Line format:** the canonical IINACT/OverlayPlugin `NN|timestamp|...` line. Supply it identically to both methods (real ACT passes `originalLogLine` to Before and a possibly-reformatted line to On - `ProxyPlugin.cs:284/289`; for IINACT use the one canonical line).
- **Gate:** both methods early-return unless `isInitialized==true` (`RealPlugin.cs:3659/3684`), set only at end of InitPlugin (`2389`). Do not feed before InitPlugin completes. `OnLogLineRead` also skips lines ending `] FB:` (`3695`).
- **Zone:** parse `01|` ChangeZone lines yourself to maintain `currentZoneName` (drives `PassesZoneRestriction`). Also raise the fake `DataSubscription.ZoneChanged(id,name)` for `${_ffxivzoneid}` (§5).

**Capturing callouts (three channels).**
1. **TTS (primary):** `plug.TtsPlaybackHook = void(string text)` (`RealPlugin.cs:384/1660`). Reached only because `cfg.TtsMethod=ACT` routes `TtsPlaybackSmart`→`TtsPlaybackAct`→hook (`1839-1864`). This captures every spoken callout string.
2. **Sound:** `plug.SoundPlaybackHook = void(string filename,int volume)` (`385/1682`); set `cfg.SoundMethod=ACT` (or `WMPUnavailable=true`). Host plays/ignores the file. `path` must be writable (remote sounds download to `path/TriggernometryRemoteSounds`).
3. **Structured (best, overlay-designed packs):** `int id = plug.RegisterNamedCallback("overlay", (CustomCallbackDelegate)((obj,val)=>emit(val)), null)` (`4199`); the `NamedCallback` action emits `plug.InvokeNamedCallback(name,val)` (`4147`; dispatch `Action.cs:4058-4063`), invoked as `Callback.DynamicInvoke(new object[]{Obj,val})` - signature `(object obj, string val)`. No UI/SharpDX.

**Uncapturable headless:** `TextAura` output is GUI-bound. Live dispatch `Action.cs:3896-3898` → `TextAuraManagement` (`RealPlugin.cs:467`) → either Scarborough/SharpDX (`703`) or `mainform.Invoke`+`AuraContainerForm` (`802/808`). Keep `UseScarborough=false`; visual-only TextAura callouts with no TTS/NamedCallback cannot be captured without a custom interception build. **Prefer TTS+NamedCallback packs.**

**Loading triggers / a real scripted pack.**
- **Local config triggers (Strategy A path):** merge the pack into `cfg.Root` inside the preset `config.xml`; `LoadConfigFromFile` (`2242`) + the real `ui.BuildFullTreeFromConfiguration()` (`2319` → `UserInterface.cs:441-465`) sets `tx.Parent` (`451`), calls `plug.AddTrigger` (`453`), and `ConditionGroup.RebuildParentage` (`456/462`). **This is the entire reason the UI is kept.**
- **TriggernometryExport packs** (`~/xiv_triggernometry`, `~/TriggernometryArchive/dist`) are `<TriggernometryExport><ExportedFolder>` XML, not full config. Load: `tex = TriggernometryExport.Unserialize(File.ReadAllText(packPath))` (`TriggernometryExport.cs:57`), attach `tex.ExportedFolder` under `cfg.Root.Folders` (set `Parent`), then let the tree walk register it (same recursion as `ImportForm.BuildTreeFromExport`, `Forms/ImportForm.cs:378-433`). Easiest: pre-merge into the config.xml so no post-init `AddTrigger` (internal) call is needed.
- **Ignore `Actions/Action*.cs`** (`ActionBase` subclasses) - dead parallel refactor (`// todo`, never instantiated). The live action is the monolithic `Action.Execute(qa,ctx)` at `Action.cs:4186` (ISO-8859 encoded; grep with `-a`).

## 5. COMBATANT BRIDGE (build UP FRONT)

The whole `${_ffxiv*}`/`${_me}`/`${_entity[..]}`/`${_party[..]}` grammar and the C#-script accessors (`BridgeFFXIV.GetMyself`/`GetAllEntities`/`GetNamedEntity`/`GetIdEntity`/`GetPartyMember`) funnel through the static `Triggernometry.PluginBridges.BridgeFFXIV`, which reaches the FFXIV plugin through ONE choke point: `GetInstance()` → `RealPlugin.InstanceHook(name,type)` returning a `PluginWrapper{pluginObj,state,...}` (`BridgeFFXIV.cs:261-286`; `RealPlugin.cs:103-111/307/387`). **`InstanceHook` is a public static settable delegate the host owns - no real DLL needed.**

**Fake-instance design (inject via InstanceHook; do NOT fork the bridge):**
```csharp
RealPlugin.InstanceHook = (n,t) => new RealPlugin.PluginWrapper {
    pluginObj = _singletonFakeActPlugin, state = 1 };   // 1 = ok (BridgeFFXIV.cs:280)

class FakeActPlugin {
    public FakeRepo         DataRepository { get; }      // reflected by name, BridgeFFXIV.cs:288
    public FakeSubscription DataSubscription { get; }    // reflected by name, BridgeFFXIV.cs:107
}
class FakeRepo {                                          // modern path bypasses legacy private-field walk
    public uint GetCurrentPlayerID();                    // BridgeFFXIV.cs:340
    public IEnumerable<FakeCombatant> GetCombatantList();// :337 - MUST return a FRESH SNAPSHOT each call
    public Process GetCurrentFFXIVProcess() => null;     // :688 (→ procid 0 / name "")
}
class FakeSubscription { public event ZoneChangedDelegate ZoneChanged; }  // delegate void(uint,string)
```
Providing `DataRepository` skips the legacy `_Memory→_config→ScanCombatants→{_CurrentPlayerID,_Combatants,_CombatantsLock}` private-field path (`BridgeFFXIV.cs:301-333`) entirely.

**`FakeCombatant` POCO - consumed purely via C# `dynamic` in `PopulateClumpFromCombatant` (`BridgeFFXIV.cs:189-238`)**, so any CLR type matching member names works. All ~31 members must exist (a missing one → `RuntimeBinderException` drops that entity, caught per-entity at `615-621`, or aborts that `UpdateState`, caught `455` - never fatal). **Hard type constraints:**

| Member | Type required | Why / file:line |
|--------|---------------|------------------|
| `Name` | `string` (ref type) | null-guard `cmx.Name==null` (`:191`) |
| `IsCasting` | `bool` | ternary + `Convert.ToInt32` (`:209-211`) |
| `CastBuffID` | integer | `.ToString("X")` (`:214`) |
| `PartyType` | `byte` / byte-enum | `(int)PartyType` + `ToString()` (`:226/:382`) |
| `ID,OwnerID,CastTargetID,TargetID` | `uint` | `ConvertToHex(Int64)`+`>0`; `ID==PlayerId` (`:205-223/:388`) |
| `Address` | `IntPtr` (`Zero` ok) | string-interp only |
| `Job` | `byte` (ToString → jobid e.g. "19") | keys `Entity.jobs` (`Entity.cs:14/49`) |
| `CurrentHP/MP/GP/CP, MaxHP/MP/GP/CP, Level, PosX/Y/Z, Heading, CastDurationCurrent/Max, EffectiveDistance, WorldID, WorldName, CurrentWorldID, BNpcNameID, BNpcID` | free numerics/strings | feed `VariableDictionary.SetValue` overloads (`VariableDictionary.cs:136-156`) |

Mirror `FFXIV_ACT_Plugin.Common.Models.Combatant` widths so `dynamic` overload resolution matches production (the 2.0.4.6-era model the version gate expects, `ProxyPlugin.cs:458-459`).

**IINACT field mapping / feed:**
- Background task consumes IINACT's combatant snapshot (OverlayPlugin-style `getCombatants` / party IPC), builds a new immutable `List<FakeCombatant>`, atomically swaps it. `GetCombatantList()` returns that reference (snapshot) - **CRITICAL** because the engine's `lock(cd.Lock)` locks a throwaway (`cd.Lock=cd`, `BridgeFFXIV.cs:345`) and does NOT protect the backing list from "collection modified" during `foreach` (`:374/517/557/598`).
- Tag the local player's combatant with the id returned by `GetCurrentPlayerID()` (→ Myself, `:388/395`). Set `PartyType=1` (party) / `2` (alliance) so `UpdateState` slotting works (`:382-417`). `cfg` is already wired (`BridgeFFXIV.cfg=cfg`, `RealPlugin.cs:2248`); default `CustomSelfFirst` sorts via `cfg.GetPartyOrderValue(jobid)` - needs reliable `Job` ids.
- Zone: raise `DataSubscription.ZoneChanged(id,name)` on `01|` lines AND redundantly set public static `BridgeFFXIV.ZoneID` (`:32`). The `ParsedLogLine`/`NetworkLogLineReceiver` unsubscribe path (`:145-179`) is **dead code** (handler undefined in tree) - ignore.
- Throttling: `UpdateState` is 500ms-throttled (`:355-361`) affecting only party/`${_me}`/`${_ffxivparty}`; per-entity `${_entity[..]}`/`GetAllEntities` are unthrottled and always read the freshest snapshot.

**Unavailable on Linux (network feed only):** `Address` (set `IntPtr.Zero`), and exact `GP/CP` of non-self combatants (set `0`). Callouts never use these. **Day-one degradation is safe:** before the feed is ready, return `state=0`/`pluginObj=null` → accessors return `_nullCombatant`/empty + warn-once, no NPE (`BridgeFFXIV.cs:266-273/511-513`).

This keeps the REAL bridge byte-for-byte (survives upstream bumps). Forking `BridgeFFXIV` is rejected (re-port every update).

## 6. SPIKE TASK LIST (Mono installed → first real callout → combatant-dependent script)

**Phase 0 - build (½ day).**
1. Restore deps Mono can't fetch from COMReferences: prebuild/obtain `Interop.WMPLib.dll` (so WMP-referencing methods JIT) and ensure SharpDX + Roslyn (`Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.*`) assemblies are present **on-disk** (non-embedded `.Location` for `Interpreter`). Compile `TriggernometryPlugin.csproj` under Mono `msbuild`/`xbuild`, TFM 4.6.2.

**Phase 1 - boot the engine headless (1 day). EXIT-CRITERION GATE.**
2. Stand up the STA host (§2): `Xvfb :99` + `DISPLAY=:99`; hidden `Form F` with forced handle; `ResetPlugin`; set `mainform`/names; register the 5 mandatory + defensive hooks; preset `config.xml` (`UseScarborough=false`, `WindowToMonitor=""`, `TtsMethod/SoundMethod=ACT`, no repos).
3. Call `plug.InitPlugin(TP, new Label())` with **one** trivial Log trigger in `cfg.Root` (regex on a fixed line → `UseTTS "hello"`).
4. **★ ABANDON-A DECISION POINT ★** Confirm `isInitialized==true` (not swallowed). Specifically verify the real `CustomControls.UserInterface` ctor (`RealPlugin.cs:2261`) AND `new SpeechSynthesizer()` (`2287`) survive Mono+Xvfb. **Time-box: 1.5 days.** If either throws (InitPlugin silently aborts, `isInitialized` stays false) and cannot be worked around via Mono config/`libgdiplus`/a System.Speech shim → **abandon A, go to Strategy B** (in-assembly patch: skip ui/tts/wmp construction, replicate the `UserInterface.cs:441-465` trigger-walk, guard the 4 `ui.Invoke` sites). See §7.

**Phase 2 - first real callout (1 day).**
5. Feed the matching line via BOTH `OnLogLineRead`/`BeforeLogLineRead`; confirm `TtsPlaybackHook` fires with "hello". Then load a **real scripted pack** (TriggernometryExport, merged into `cfg.Root`); feed a captured IINACT log replay; capture callouts via `TtsPlaybackHook` + a `RegisterNamedCallback`. **Exit: ≥1 real callout from a real pack's scripted trigger.**
6. Verify `ExecuteScript` (Roslyn) actually compiled: run a pack trigger using a C# script; confirm `scripting` is non-null (else `Interpreter.cs:326` reference-gathering failed - fix on-disk assembly locations). **Time-box: if Roslyn cannot be made to compile under Mono after 1 day → escalate (script triggers are the core goal).**

**Phase 3 - combatant-dependent script (1-2 days).**
7. Stand up the §5 fake instance + a static snapshot (hardcoded party + boss). Verify `${_me.job}`, `${_ffxivparty[1].job}`, `${_entity[bnpcid=..].currenthp}` resolve, and a script reading `BridgeFFXIV.GetMyself()` works.
8. Wire the live IINACT combatant feed (snapshot swap, player-id tag, PartyType, ZoneChanged). **Exit: a combatant-dependent scripted callout fires correctly off live data.**
9. Post-load routing sweep (§3 item 5) + smoke a pack that uses per-action `TTSRouting`.

## 7. FALLBACK-TO-B TRIGGERS (Strategy A is dead → recompile in-assembly)

Strategy B = build `triggernometry-core` **in-assembly** (or add `[assembly: InternalsVisibleTo("triggernometry-core")]` - **none exists today**, verified) and patch `InitPlugin` behind a headless flag: skip `ui = new ...` (2261) and `new SpeechSynthesizer()` (2287); replicate the `UserInterface.cs:441-465` walk (set `tx.Parent`, `AddTrigger`, `RebuildParentage`); guard the 4 `ui.Invoke` sites; disable repos.

Switch to B if the spike hits ANY of:

1. **Mono cannot construct `CustomControls.UserInterface`** under Xvfb (`RealPlugin.cs:2261` throws - DataGridViewEx / custom-painted controls / `libgdiplus` quirks). This is the headline risk; A has no UI-less seam so a non-constructible UI kills A. (Spike step 4.)
2. **`new SpeechSynthesizer()` throws on Mono** (`RealPlugin.cs:2287`, unguarded) and no System.Speech facade/shim works → InitPlugin silently aborts (`isInitialized=false`). (Spike step 4.) - In B this line is simply skipped.
3. **`isInitialized` never becomes true** for any other reason in the real InitPlugin under Mono (outer catch at `2391-2394` swallows the cause) and the failing construct can't be config-avoided.
4. **Roslyn `Interpreter` cannot compile under Mono** (`Interpreter.cs:326-329` throws on reference-gathering and can't be fixed by on-disk assemblies) - but note this also threatens B (it's the same engine), so this is "escalate" not purely "switch to B."
5. **The kept-UI message pump / `ui.Invoke` action path deadlocks or NPEs** in practice (`ActionTriggerOperation.cs:413/433`, `ActionFolderOperation.cs:113/134`) such that enable/disable-trigger actions can't run reliably - B guards these 4 sites directly.
6. **Mono `Form.IsHandleCreated` never reaches true** under Xvfb without a fully-running native window (so `ReadyForOperation` at `3979` stays false and worker threads spin forever) - though B has the same `mainform` gate, so first try harder on the handle; only a fundamental Mono+Xvfb WinForms failure forces a rethink of both.

Items 1 and 2 are the true A-vs-B deciders and are both resolved by a single Mono runtime smoke test (Phase 1 step 4). Everything else in A is config-gated or stubbable per the dimension maps.
